journal_lines: Dense jungle. Every trunk laced with vines.
Something large moved through the understory. Held still.
Orchids growing from a wound in the bark.
The trees here do not fall cleanly.
The vines made everything longer to cut. And heavier.
Rain constant in here even without clouds. Canopy drip.
The trunk diameters are three times what the forest has.
Something screamed in the canopy. High and brief. Not investigated.
The air at ground level is warmer and wetter than the surface.
Found the jungle clearing. Good standing timber at the edge.
Parrots observed the work for a while then left.
The cut log disappeared into the undergrowth before I could move it.
Vines grew faster than expected. The path closed almost immediately.
Dark in the undergrowth even at midday.
Every surface in here is growing something.
